$comment: The registry that drives everything. Adding a game means adding an entry here
and running the pipeline — no code changes.
Every field must come from a scraped or primary source, never from recall.
'status' is one of: live (built and shipping), planned (declared, not built yet).
grid   - a columns x rows PC box grid, the normal case from Gen 3 on
list   - Gen 1/2, where the storage UI is a scrolling name list, not a grid
single - one very large box (Let's Go), no grid
pasture- Legends Arceus pastures; same capacity, different presentation
A game may have several regional dexes (Kalos is split in three, Galar and
Paldea each add DLC dexes), so 'dexes' is always an array.
